question: In which year was the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act passed?
solution:
The correct answer is **1976**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act** is one of the most significant amendments to the Indian Constitution.
 
• It was passed in the year **1976** during the Emergency period under Prime Minister Indira Gandhi.
 
• The amendment is also known as the **"Mini-Constitution"** due to the extensive changes it introduced.
 
• Key changes included the addition of the words **"Socialist," "Secular,"** and **"Integrity"** to the Preamble.
 
• It also curtailed the power of the judiciary and increased the powers of the Parliament.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Area of Change
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Preamble**
 Added the words **"Socialist," "Secular,"** and **"Integrity"**.
 
 

 **Directive Principles**
 Made them more comprehensive and emphasized their importance.
 
 

 **Judiciary**
 Reduced the power of the judiciary in favor of the Parliament.
 
 

 **Fundamental Duties**
 Introduced a list of **Fundamental Duties** for citizens.
 
 

 **Emergency Provisions**
 Made significant changes to the **Emergency Provisions** in the Constitution.
